comment: Curated applicant-tracking-system hosts: static host permissions + the small hint script. Match patterns, one per line, https only, host-wide (Chrome ignores the path of a host permission, so a path would only look narrower than it is). Extend, never loosen: every entry is a vendor's own domain, never a TLD, a job board or a general-purpose cloud. The hint script also runs on every page of these hosts, so a vendor domain that also serves employee-facing pages is a trade-off (see oraclecloud.com, csod.com, ultipro.com).

added.https://*.tal.net/*: Oleeo Tal.net (UK graduate schemes: <employer>.tal.net/vx/...). Candidate-facing only.
added.https://*.oraclecloud.com/*: Oracle Recruiting Cloud candidate sites (<tenant>.fa.<region>.oraclecloud.com/hcmUI/CandidateExperience/...). The domain also hosts Oracle Fusion employee apps: the match pattern cannot be narrowed to the candidate path for a host permission, so the hint can show on an employee form there; one click hides it for the site.
added.https://*.csod.com/*: Cornerstone OnDemand career sites (<tenant>.csod.com/ats/careersite/...). The domain also serves the learning product.
added.https://*.ultipro.com/*: UKG Pro Recruiting job boards (recruiting.ultipro.com/<tenant>/JobBoard/...). The domain also serves UKG's employee HR.
added.https://*.jobtrain.co.uk/*: Jobtrain (UK public sector and NHS Scotland: www.jobtrain.co.uk/<employer>/...).
added.https://*.webrecruit.co.uk/*: Webrecruit ATS applicant portals (UK public bodies and charities: fusion.webrecruit.co.uk).
added.https://app.beapplied.com/*: Applied (beapplied.com redirects to app.beapplied.com): the one host, no wildcard.
added.https://join.com/*: JOIN multiposting ATS (join.com/companies/<employer>/<id>): the one host, no wildcard.

notAdded.greenhouse eu / lever eu: Already covered: job-boards.eu.greenhouse.io is under *.greenhouse.io and jobs.eu.lever.co under *.lever.co.
notAdded.infojobs.net, tecnoempleo.com, welcometo: Job boards, not application systems: they redirect to the employer's own ATS, and their domains hold the candidate's account. Use a toolbar click or an always-on site rule.
notAdded.eploy.net: Hiring-manager logins live there; candidate sites run on each employer's own domain.
notAdded.tribepad.com, hireful, candidate.hr: No candidate-facing host could be verified from the vendor.
notAdded.hibob.com, factorialhr.com, talentclue.c: Employee or marketing domains; no dedicated candidate-site host could be verified.
